text.en: Pet owners appreciate the clean, roomy kennel units and well-maintained exercise spaces for large and small dogs. Clients frequently note that dogs return home clean and in good physical form. However, one owner found the rural location somewhat difficult to locate without navigation, and another raised serious concerns regarding kennel supervision.

title.en: Handling for nervous and rescue dogs

text.en: Multiple reviewers highlight that the team handles anxious rescues and reactive breeds with attentive patience. Owners of German Shepherds and Belgian Malinois report that their pets settle comfortably and greet staff enthusiastically. Although one client reported a traumatic stay for an elderly dog, most pet parents express complete peace of mind.

Regular clients praise the kennel team and Betty for their professional dedication and friendly reception. Pet owners value the reassuring updates and note that kennel attendants manage individual canine temperaments skilfully. Nonetheless, one reviewer expressed profound dissatisfaction regarding communication following their pet's stay.

q.en: Does Best Buddies accommodate reactive or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, owners of rescues and sensitive breeds note that staff cater well to specific canine temperaments.

q.en: Are the boarding facilities clean and spacious?

a.en: Reviewers describe the kennel blocks as large, hygienic, and well suited for dogs of all sizes.

q.en: Is the kennel facility easy to locate?

a.en: The facility is set in a rural location outside Cork, which clients note is straightforward to reach using satellite navigation.

q.en: How are dogs returned to their owners after boarding?

a.en: Clients report that dogs are returned clean, settled, and in good physical condition after their boarding period.
